text: Wiring the three MCP tools into tools.js.

All four ways (a)–(d) are done, and so is the judge. **Forking the Page checkpoint answers a page question in about 3 seconds for about 3 cents, and a blind Opus judge scored it 2.6 out of 3.** Everything is committed on `worktree/module-experts` (`fa99e96e`, `7be87850`). Nothing is merged.

**Built**
- **Recipe:** `public/framework/core/Page/expert.json`. It loads the readme chain, 10 Page files in full (Page.class.js, words.js, Log.js, columns.md, declaring.md, jsonl.md and others) plus Router's readme and Router.js. That comes to about 78k tokens. 24 more files are listed on demand.
- **`Servex/agents/experts.js`:**
  - `load_module(modules)` returns the reading as data. It dedupes the readme chain across modules.
  - `readme()` is `load_module` formatted as one prompt text.
  - `build()` makes a base or derived checkpoint. `fresh()` re-hashes the files a checkpoint read. `ask()` rebuilds a stale checkpoint first, then forks it; `deep:true` uses Opus.
  - The index is `Servex/experts.json`, and there is a CLI.
- **MCP tools** in `tools.js`: `ask_expert`, `list_experts`, `load_module` and `readme_modules`. `server(host, ctx, list)` now takes an optional list, so an in-process SDK server can carry only the loader.
- **Docs:** `Servex/agents/doc/experts.md`, plus a section and a Files line in `Servex/agents/readme.md`. The one-liner is in the mastermind, sub-mastermind and every-prompt skills.
- **Proof:** `Servex/agents/experts-proof.mjs` runs on a private host with its own index. It wrote `proof.md` and `proof.json` into the worktree's task dir, and 19 curation lines into `core/Page/doc/readme-log.jsonl`.

**Proof (Sonnet, 5 questions, blind Opus judge)**

| way | first answer | cost a question | score /3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| a. fork the checkpoint | 3.1 s | $0.032 | 2.6 |
| b. load_module tool | 25.5 s | $0.196 | 2.6 |
| c. preloaded prompt | 2.8 s | $0.381 | 3.0 |
| d. cold | 13.4 s | $0.156 | 2.2 |

- **Building the checkpoint** is a one-time cost of $0.32 (the first, uncached build measured $0.45).
- **Freshness test passed.** With one recorded hash changed, `fresh()` said stale, `ask()` rebuilt the checkpoint first, and `fresh()` said fresh afterwards.
- **Cold's 0 on question 4** is a real non-answer: it started a background subagent and ended its turn waiting. Its other four answers average 2.75.
- **The preload (c) never caches across sessions.** The question sits in the same message as the bundle, so every run pays the full ~78k tokens again. A fork caches because the bundle is in an earlier turn.
- **Curation signal (advice only, not applied):**
  - Loaded but never drawn on: `readme.md`, `navigation.md`, `layout-overview.md`, `watch-out.md`, `words.js`, `jsonl/page.jsonl`, and Router's readme.
  - Needed but not loaded: the `display: contents` rules in Page.css, `md_folder()`, `fs_folder()`, and `PageLog.Reader`.

**Costs:** about $6.10 of the $9 budget ($4.62 for the full run, $1.32 for a smoke run, plus a rebuild).

**Things you should know**
- **`load_module` on the live Servex will be refused as it stands.** Claude Code caps MCP tool output at 25k tokens and the Page bundle is about 78k. The fix is setting `MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS` (for example to 150000) in `.claude/settings.json`'s `env` or in Servex's launch. Both are outside my fence; the proof set it only in its own process.
- **A fork's reported cost includes the whole base session's cost.** The SDK's `total_cost_usd` adds up across a resume, so `ask()` subtracts the checkpoint's own total.
- **Real tokens run about 2.25 characters each in this repo, not 4.** My first recipe was 95k tokens, not the 54k I estimated. The trimmed one is 78k, above the 40–60k aim, because I kept columns.md for the `display: contents` question.
- **I did not boot Servex with the new `tools.js`.** Importing it works and the proof used it, but the first real boot happens at your merge and restart.
- **`readme-chain.js` wasn't on this branch yet,** so `experts.js` imports it if present and otherwise uses a small built-in walk.
- **No edit to `core/Page/readme.md`,** per your fence change. The proof ran on the v1 readme and its hash is recorded, so the curated readme will read stale and trigger a rebuild.
- **I copied Servex's `node_modules` into the worktree** as a real copy (gitignored, not a junction) so the SDK import works.
Done: `MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS` is set to 150000 in `.claude/settings.json`, with one line about it under `load_module` in `Servex/agents/doc/experts.md` (commit `900b1c78`).

## Done

All three deliverables in my fence are built, verified, and clean of console errors.

**1. `core/Page/readme.md`** — rewritten: 64 lines → 36. Added the expert line (`ask_expert core/Page …`), listed all five ways to make a page (added "a readme as the page"), and dropped one dead link (`tools/`, which has no real page). The old readme is preserved verbatim at `core/Page/old/readme-v1.md`, linked from `old/readme.md`.

**2. Layout hub** (`core/Page/layout/`) — now shows icon-card sections first (the five shapes, then 9 links into the whole layout system: the `/layouts/` encyclopedia, browse/decide/practice/labs/shell, `core/Layout`, the sidebar variant, and the layout explorer), then its own `readme.md` rendered underneath as prose. The old page moved to `layout/v1/`, reachable as a child tab. (Mid-task the layout explorer landed on `michael/dev` at `/layouts/explorer/` — I updated both mentions from "being built" to a real link, per your note.)

**3. Readme-as-page example** (`core/Page/make/readme-page/`) — a real page whose whole content is its own `readme.md` via `md.file()`, plus one JS-built icon section under it. `make/page.js` now has a "5. readme.md" section showing the source and the rendered result side by side, plus three lines on when markdown falls short (custom modules, a class on a span, live widgets).

**Caught and fixed along the way:** both new pages initially threw `this.append is not a function` — `Page` isn't a `View`, so the promise from `md.file()` has to be appended onto a real `div()`, not `this`. Found this with a headless proof pass before trusting it.

**Proof:** zero console/page errors, zero failed requests on all three required screenshots (1920px) plus 18 other links I followed from the new text — all in the task log. Screenshots: `shot-page.png`, `shot-layout.png`, `shot-readme-page.png` in the task dir.

Full decision trail is in `task.jsonl`. I didn't run `finish-task` — this task has a sibling minion (`minion-experts-build`) still in flight, so the task-mastermind lands it.

All six fixes are done, committed (not merged), and verified. Here's the summary:

1. **Double title** — fixed. `make/readme-page/page.js` and `layout/page.js` now pass `md.file(import.meta, "readme.md", { h1: false })` — the framework's own built-in opt-out for exactly this case. Screenshots at 1920: [readme-page](file:///C:/Users/mike/AppData/Local/Temp/ask-shot-1790715429614.png), [layout](file:///C:/Users/mike/AppData/Local/Temp/ask-shot-1790715431299.png) — one title each, confirmed.
2. **Layout hub said everything twice** — fixed. `layout/readme.md` cut from a repeating table+list down to "choosing one," the word-collision note, and a plain link index.
3. **One pattern** — fixed. Docs (`make/page.js`, `make/readme-page/readme.md`) now show both the one-liner (readme-only) and the wrapper (JS follows) forms and say which is which, matching what the live pages actually do.
6. **Freshness too wide** — fixed. `experts.js` no longer hashes chain readmes into the staleness set, only the recipe's own `load`/`also` files — verified with a direct call (15 hashed files, 0 overlap with the 3 chain entries).
8. **Root readme possibly duplicated** — checked, not a bug: `build()`'s spawn sets neither `task` nor `page`, so Agents.js's own chain-prepend never fires. Proved with no model call (`item8-no-double-chain.mjs`, now in the task dir) — 32 headings, root readme exactly once. No code change needed.
10. **Doc names the default** — fixed. `experts.md` now states `ask_expert` as the default and `load_module` as the exception, citing proof.md's cost table.

Bonus fix: while proving zero console errors, `Server/smoke.mjs` itself had a bug (resolved relative links against the server root instead of the page they were found on), which false-failed a perfectly working link. Fixed that one line too, and reran clean.

Verification: `node --check` on every edited file, `readme-chain.test.mjs` 18/18, and `Server/smoke.mjs` against all four required pages plus everything they link to — exit 0, zero console/page/request errors.

Committed as `aacb2ee6` on `worktree/module-experts` (9 files, exact paths, not merged). Full log at the task's `task.jsonl` under `public/framework/ai/2026-09-29/module-experts/`.
